Package smart_food_delivery.service

Class OrderService

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.service.OrderService
public class OrderService extends Object
Manages food orders in the Smart Food Delivery Management System. This service creates standard, express, and scheduled orders, validates order information, assigns unique order IDs, and allows pending orders to be cancelled.

      public Order placeOrder(Restaurant restaurant, List<OrderItem> items, String address, String zone)
      Places a standard order using the original order creation method. This method is kept for compatibility with existing parts of the system.
      Parameters:
      restaurant - the selected restaurant
      items - the ordered items
      address - the delivery address
      zone - the delivery zone
      Returns:
      the newly created standard order
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the order information is invalid

    • placeExpressOrder

      public ExpressOrder placeExpressOrder(Restaurant restaurant, List<OrderItem> items, String address, String zone, double expressFee)
      Creates and saves an express delivery order. Express orders include an additional express fee.
      Parameters:
      restaurant - the selected restaurant
      items - the ordered items
      address - the delivery address
      zone - the delivery zone
      expressFee - the additional express delivery fee
      Returns:
      the newly created express order
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the order information or express fee is invalid

    • placeScheduledOrder

      public ScheduledOrder placeScheduledOrder(Restaurant restaurant, List<OrderItem> items, String address, String zone, LocalDateTime scheduledTime)
      Creates a scheduled order using the system clock. The scheduled delivery time must be in the future.
      Parameters:
      restaurant - the selected restaurant
      items - the ordered items
      address - the delivery address
      zone - the delivery zone
      scheduledTime - the requested delivery date and time
      Returns:
      the newly created scheduled order
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the order data is invalid or the scheduled time is not in the future

    • placeScheduledOrder

      public ScheduledOrder placeScheduledOrder(Restaurant restaurant, List<OrderItem> items, String address, String zone, LocalDateTime scheduledTime, Clock clock)
      Creates a scheduled order using a specified clock. Providing a clock allows deterministic testing of future delivery times.
      Parameters:
      restaurant - the selected restaurant
      items - the ordered items
      address - the delivery address
      zone - the delivery zone
      scheduledTime - the requested delivery date and time
      clock - the clock used for time validation
      Returns:
      the newly created scheduled order
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the order data, scheduled time, or clock is invalid
